easy.def: The same in size, amount or value.
examples: The two pieces are equal.
We got equal slices.
Two plus two is equal to four.

more.def: The same in amount, size or value as something else.
examples: The two pieces of pizza were equal.
Everyone has an equal chance to win.
Two halves are equal to one whole.
Two plus two equals four.
Ten equals ten.
One dime equals ten cents.

more.def: To be the same amount or value as something else.
examples: Three times two equals six.
Ten pennies equal one dime.
Her score equaled the highest in the class.
We equip the team.
She equipped the boat.
They were equipped with maps.

more.def: To supply someone or something with what is needed.
examples: We equipped the team with new uniforms.
The boat is equipped with life jackets.
The hikers were equipped with maps and water.

easy.def: The tools and things you need for a job or game.
examples: We have soccer equipment.
The equipment is in the shed.
I put away the equipment.

more.def: The tools, machines or other things needed for a certain activity.
examples: The team keeps its equipment in a big bag.
Firefighters carry special equipment to put out a fire.
The gym teacher put away the equipment after class.
